label.purpose: Receipt metadata fields; not an eyebrow above every section.

motion.name: swipe-nav
motion.purpose: Swipe navigation between screens in the same tab task family.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Persimmon action button with tactile press-scale response.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #E85A1F; color: #FAFAF7; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF9E76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-color: #A1370C; transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Grid quick-action button such as New Sale or Scan Item.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { background-color: #E85A1F; color: #FAFAF7; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF9E76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-action:active { background-color: #A1370C; transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Summary Card
components.description: Flat paper metric card with a dashed receipt border.
components.css: .ds-summary-card { background-color: #FAFAF7; border: 1px dashed #D2CCC1; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-summary-title { color: #564E45; font-size: 14px; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-summary-value { color: #0E0C0A; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Flat paper input with a persimmon-300 focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background-color: #FAFAF7; color: #0E0C0A; border: 1px solid #D2CCC1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #FF9E76; outline: 2px solid #FF9E76; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Fully rounded filter pill; cinnamon fill for primary selection, ink fill for secondary.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { background-color: #F2F0E8; color: #28231D; border: 1px solid #D2CCC1; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF9E76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill-on { background-color: #623418; border-color: #623418; color: #FAFAF7; }

components.name: Alert Badge
components.description: Small status badge for low stock, expiring, or overdue items.
components.css: .ds-alert-badge { display: inline-block; background-color: #EEF4E5; color: #4F7A24; border: 1px solid #4F7A24; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'StackSansText', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
SariSari is styled with a cozy, tactile countertop feel, evoking the presence of the traditional Filipino garapon candy jars and paper receipts. The interface relies on warm-neutral backgrounds, crisp charcoal ink typography, and the interactive mascot Sari who guides the store owner through tasks and states.

The system rejects cold, over-decorated modern SaaS landing pages. Layouts prioritize rapid data entry at a physical counter, readability under direct ambient sunlight, and offline responsiveness.
keyCharacteristics: Warm & Cozy Tactility: Flat surfaces resembling cream-toned ledger paper and physical receipts.
Mascot-Led Context: Sari (the garapon) is integrated directly into main views to signal store states (readiness, alerts, sales success).
High-Density Utility: Optimized for single-column mobile viewports with fast POS checkouts and transaction ledger audit trails.

rules.name: The Persimmon Accent Rule
rules.body: Saturated Persimmon Orange (#E85A1F) must only carry active actions or status focus. Never use it decoratively for large header panels, borders, or container backdrops.

rules.name: The Receipt Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body text must be written in Soft Charcoal Ink (#0E0C0A) to guarantee readability against cream paper under intense daylight.

rules.name: The Alert Color Contract
rules.body: When an alert kind appears as a chip, pill, badge, or filter, its icon color must match this palette verbatim. Do not introduce a fifth literal — promote any new alert kind here first.

rules.name: The Letter-Spacing Rule
rules.body: Large display headers must not set letter-spacing tighter than -0.02em (or -0.03em for hero metrics) to prevent overlapping characters on low-DPI mobile devices.

rules.name: The No-Display-In-UI Rule
rules.body: Never use display fonts or clamp size scales for regular UI buttons, inputs, or navigation labels. Keep them strictly mapped to body and title tokens.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: All list entries, static cards, and inputs must lie flat on their backgrounds. Shadows are strictly active state changes or modal indicators.

dos: Use the mascot Sari in empty states, dashboards, and alert backgrounds to provide contextual feedback.
Design for rapid POS entry: large tap targets, minimal steps, immediate feedback.
Maintain high contrast: body text in Soft Charcoal Ink (#0E0C0A) on Cream Page Background (#EFE6D2) or Brightest Receipt Paper (#FBF7EE).
Use bottom tabs for primary navigation (Home, Sales, Inventory, Customers, More) with swipe gestures inside tabs for related screens.
Keep detail screens in stack navigation to preserve context.
Show sync status, offline/online badge, and date/time in the header for instant operational awareness.
Present status summary cards (Today’s Sales, Expected Profit, Low Stock Count, Credits Due) as a glanceable dashboard.
Provide a grid of primary actions (New Sale, Scan Item, Add Stock, Add Customer, View Alerts, Reports) for one‑tap access.
Display a today snapshot of recent operations (latest sale, recent payment, stock update, customer payment).
Highlight priority alerts (low stock, expiring items, overdue payments, unsynced transactions) with action buttons.
Include mini‑insights (best‑selling item, fast‑moving category, most overdue customer) to turn data into action.
Show a recent activity feed (last 5‑10 operations) for traceability and confidence.
donts: Use side‑stripe borders as decoration on cards or alerts.
Apply gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
Use generic warm‑neutral gradients as page backgrounds; stick to flat cream or paper tones.
Set card rounding radii larger than 16px.
Use display fonts or large clamp scales for regular UI buttons, inputs, or navigation labels.
Add arbitrary loading spinners; prefer skeleton states where possible.
Use tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Number sections as default scaffolding (01 / 02 / 03) unless the sequence carries real meaning.
